fieldValues.title: No core changes until the process is refined
fieldValues.decision_question: May this work change srs-rust or the spec while the process is still being refined?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Allow core changes where they help; or hold core still and extend through package relations.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Standing rule: no core (srs-rust or spec) changes until the process is refined. Extend through package relations. check-method is clerk general method and governance code, not core.
fieldValues.rationale: The process is still moving. Changing core first would fix the wrong shape in place.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the process has settled and a duplicate such as canon() is ready to move into core.
